source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper uses independent complete randomization, permits four exposure outcomes at fixed treated fractions, defines equal k-sized blocks on each side, proves Procedure 3.2 finite-sample valid, and presents k selection as a power trade-off/heuristic.

The article constructs conditional randomization tests under general interference through bicliques of units and assignments, relates biclique size to power, and uses graph-clustering methods to find bicliques.
Imputability under a conditioning mechanism yields a valid conditional randomization p-value at every level.
The paper develops exact permutation tests for randomized group formation and identifies equivariance as the condition translating design invariance to exposure invariance.
